LanguageData.FB_VoiceOrgan.label: voice organ
LanguageData.FB_VoiceOrgan.description: A grown vocal organ that mimics a human radio operator. A living carrier is seated inside its throat, suspended so it neither ages nor starves, and the organ speaks with that person's voice: traders and factions on the other end hear a colony of people. It answers only while a carrier is held, and its social skill decides how the haggling goes.
LanguageData.FB_VoiceOrganEmbryo.label: voice organ embryo
LanguageData.FB_VoiceOrganEmbryo.description: An immature vocal organ that will grow into a voice organ.
LanguageData.FB_FleshTradeBeacon.label: flesh trade beacon
LanguageData.FB_FleshTradeBeacon.description: A pulsing marker of flesh that tells the voice organ which goods lie ready for sale. Anything stacked within its reach can be traded away to orbital ships.
